scheduling."},{"requirement_id":"R2","evidence":"Develop increasingly detailed cost estimates through design, evaluate alternatives, submit estimates for review and approval at each phase, and flag overruns with corrective recommendations."},{"requirement_id":"R3","evidence":"Prepare and negotiate a detailed guaranteed-maximum-price proposal, documenting drawings, specifications, assumptions, showing percentage completion and other owner-required information."},{"requirement_id":"R7","evidence":"Maintain cost controls against the schedule of values, monitor actual and remaining costs and
